biography:
Having carved out a great reputation in Enterprise Sales, Jerred has taken on a new role with Digital Realty assisting SMBs with colocation/data center needs.

Jerred has worked with some of the largest hospital organizations, law firms, retailers, and gaming companies. This combination gives him a deep understanding of what SMBs are looking for when considering colocations.

Satisfied clients praise Jerred for his “high integrity and ethics,” while his “honesty” and “straightforward” approach are referenced in almost every testimonial.
